about: The answer key for the Layer 2 replay (IMPROVEMENT-PLAN item 21). Two small synthetic services built on docs/LEGA-CORPUS.md's Leg A idea, so the ground truth is known by construction and nothing is cloned. This file sits beside the repositories, never inside one: replay copies only each repository directory, so no model reads it. Each plant is matched by location (a quote whose enclosing definition is the planted one, or a quote that contains an anchor line) or by mention (a verified quote in a planted file whose title or reasoning names the planted route or function).

plants.describe: POST /admin/users/<id>/password lost @admin_required; its three admin siblings keep it, so any logged-in user can reset any user's password.
GET /notes/<id> loads any note by id; its PUT, DELETE and share siblings go through owned_note_or_404.
GET /files/<path:name> joins the caller's path onto the upload directory unchecked; the DELETE sibling runs it through secure_filename.
GET /notes/search interpolates the q parameter into SQL; every other query is parameterised.

anchors: f"AND title LIKE '%{q}%' ORDER BY id DESC").fetchall()

plants.describe: GET /api/tickets/:id/history lost auth.requireUser; its eight siblings keep it, and the handler does no organisation check either.
POST /api/admin/users/:id/role lost auth.requireAdmin; its three admin siblings keep it, so any user can make themselves admin.
GET /api/comments/:commentId returns any comment by id; every ticket and comment sibling checks the ticket's orgId against the caller's.
